prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function circularDeltas(input: string): string | null
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed decimal integers in -1000..1000. Return next-minus-current for each position, with the first value following the last; a singleton returns 0. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 2,5,1 returns 3,-4,1.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const nums=(s:string):number[]|null=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};export function circularDeltas(s:string):string|null{let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;return a.map((x,i)=>a[(i+1)%a.length]-x).join(',')}
